scientific_limitations_integrity: Finite order-five exhaustive proof with supplied code and full 2048-row certificate. This counts phrases, not encoded bits, and does not generalize to other orders. Source date 2014-09-04 is the earliest exactly day-dated public posting verified among inspected LZ78 sources; the 1978 foundational source has only September 1978 month-level bibliographic precision, not a verified day. Novelty has residual unindexed-publication risk; independent audit not performed.
title: Complete cyclic LZ78 phrase-spectrum of binary de Bruijn cycles of order five
